title: Harry S. Kahn Senior Lecturer in Social Policy, Emeritus
affiliation: Harry S. Kahn Senior Lecturer in Social Policy, Emeritus
bio: Julie Boatright Wilson is the Harry Kahn Senior Lecturer in Social Policy. She is the Faculty co-Chair of two Harvard Kennedy School executive programs: Performance Measurement for Effective Management of Nonprofit Organizations (joint with Harvard Business School) and Leading Successful Social Programs: Using Evidence to Assess Effectiveness.
research_interests: Health Human Rights Social Policy Fairness & Justice Cities & Communities Gender
